annotation.title_clean: Avances en el desarrollo de la Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) fueron presentados por la Senacyt y Georgia Tech
annotation.title_en: Progress on the development of the National Artificial Intelligence (AI) Strategy presented by Senacyt and Georgia Tech
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Secretaría Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Senacyt)
annotation.summary_en: Press release from Panama's Senacyt on presenting, with Georgia Tech, preliminary results of the first stage of the National AI Strategy: an ecosystem assessment (SWOT) highlighting connectivity and renewable energy strengths and gaps in STEM talent, computing infrastructure, data governance and R&D investment.
key_provisions_or_claims: First stage of Panama's National AI Strategy: ecosystem assessment completed
Strengths: connectivity, renewable energy, research data assets, logistics infrastructure
Gaps: STEM talent, computing infrastructure, data governance, R&D investment
Georgia Tech work covers readiness assessment, strategic alternatives, implementation plan
Full report to be published with final strategy
